sources.revenue_growth: FY2027 +17.93% and FY2028 +19.66%: analyst consensus (Yahoo Finance, ~50 analysts, Oct 17 2026). FY2029-2036: no consensus exists; growth declines in a straight line to the terminal rate (Damodaran's high-growth-to-stable method). Microsoft guided only 'double-digit' growth for FY2027; Q1 FY2027 guide is +16-17%.
sources.ebit_margin: 46.0%: FY2026 actual was 46.8% (10-K); management guided FY2027 operating margin to fall by less than 1 point (Q4 FY2026 earnings call, Jul 29 2026). No longer-term guidance; held flat.
sources.tax_rate: 20%: management guidance for FY2027 effective tax rate (Q4 FY2026 earnings call). FY2026 actual 19.4%.
sources.da_pct_revenue: 11.61% = FY2026 'Depreciation, amortization, and other' $38,534M / revenue $331,839M (10-K cash flow statement). Held flat.
sources.capex_pct_revenue: FY2027 44.6%: Q1 FY2027 capex guided at 'over $50B' including finance leases; x4 = $200B, times the 87% cash share seen in Q4 FY2026 ($35.8B cash of $41B total) = $175B, consistent with ~$175B calendar-2026 guidance. Microsoft gave no full-year FY2027 figure. Then declines in a straight line to 12.7%, Microsoft's own pre-AI average (FY2022-23, 10-K), by year 10. The fade path is a method, not a data point - see sensitivity.
sources.nwc_pct_revenue: Average of FY2022-2026 non-cash working capital / revenue from the 10-Ks (negative: customers pay Microsoft before it delivers).
sources.equity_risk_premium: 4.23%: Damodaran implied US equity risk premium, January 2026 (latest figure found; he updates monthly at pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar).
sources.pre_tax_cost_of_debt: 6.05%: Moody's Seasoned Aaa corporate bond yield, Oct 15 2026 (FRED series DAAA). Microsoft is rated AAA/Aaa.
sources.debt_to_capital: 2.79%: debt $40.3B + finance lease liabilities $66.6B (FY2026 10-K) vs market cap $3.72T (Yahoo Finance, Oct 16 2026 close $529.05).
sources.terminal_growth: 3.8%: CBO long-run US real GDP growth 1.8% + inflation 2.0% (Budget and Economic Outlook 2026-2036). A company cannot outgrow the economy forever; must stay below the risk-free rate (Damodaran).
sources.shares_outstanding: 7.43B: current shares outstanding, Yahoo Finance, Oct 2026.
sources.cash_and_debt: Cash = cash, equivalents and short-term investments $76.8B (FY2026 10-K). Debt includes finance leases; operating leases excluded because their payments are already deducted inside EBIT.
